description: This file defines an Angular directive 'TbJsonToStringDirective' that converts JSON objects to string representation and vice versa, providing validation and error handling for JSON input fields.

classes.name: TbJsonToStringDirective
classes.description: An Angular directive that binds JSON objects to input fields as strings, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Handles input events, parses JSON string to object, updates internal state, and propagates changes.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the control is in an error state based on validation and user interaction.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current JSON parsing state, returns validation errors if JSON is invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a JSON object to the input element as a string, resets parse error state.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback function to mark the control as touched.
